title: Claim
description: A single, atomic, falsifiable assertion made within an investigation. Claims are the testable units of an investigation. Connections to evidence are expressed exclusively through ClaimEvidenceLink entities (never stored on the claim); the evidential verdict on a claim is expressed by Assessment entities that reference it. Backlinks are derived by tooling, not stored.

id.description: Stable entity identifier in format boe:claim:<ulid>. Constant across versions.

investigation_id.description: The investigation this claim belongs to.

statement.description: The claim stated precisely and falsifiably. Must be a single atomic assertion. Must be in past tense for historical events.

context.description: Background context necessary to understand the claim. Does not constitute evidence.
